svg.aria-label: A learning management system and course marketplace for students, instructors and admins: course publishing, quizzes and analytics, Google sign-in, Stripe checkout with coupons and invoices, and AI tools for notes, quiz generation and answer checking. Why it is interesting: The AI layer is provider-agnostic: one interface over OpenAI, Gemini and Anthropic written against their raw HTTP APIs, with no SDKs. Scanned or photographed answers are read with Tesseract OCR before an LLM grades them.
